scope: Independent review of browser agent protocol/C VPI/HDL wrapper/scenarios/driver changes. Supervisor was authored by this reviewer and separately reviewed by root and browser. No runtime or whole-S9 acceptance is inferred.

closed_findings.fix: Order retains interval events after prior completion and before the requested future input; completion still cannot predate its request.
Explicit actual AXI posedge count1..1024 for bus operations;0 for other operations. Reserved words remain checked.
Public typed responses are validated through the shared strict frame decoder before ordering acceptance.
Value-change callback only captures bounded4096-event FIFO entries. RO callbacks transmit; Ready/Complete explicitly flush prior events before receipt/admission.
Strictly future cbReadWriteSynch gives old active/inactive/NBA work before the input batch; no time adjustment. The exact live-control code is reused by the split/unsplit clock oracle.

Separate current-cohort baseline and live invocations retain their own actual programs. The temporary compiler tree is removed only after successful compilation, clean diagnostics and plugin hash. No VVP equality/reuse or artifact normalization is assumed.

checked_contracts: Fixed128-byte private inherited FD3 frames; stdout/stderr remain vendor logs. Actual four-state X/Z vectors retained; no supplied bus reply.
C VPI handle widths/types and request argument/reserved-bit bounds match Rust. Initialization receipt is transport-only.
Absolute Q32 half-clock edges round up to1ps without repeated rounding drift. First enable low, gating holds, rephase preserves level; digital phase policy is explicit.
All72 register/strobe/reset checks operate on live observed responses. Wire and text observations are joined exactly, including the known PS7 no-CPU notice.
Old profile uses original benchmark and unchanged handshake task. Shared primitive/RAM/strict elaboration/original-firmware-contract checks stay in both modes.
Live profile is pinned to exact shim and compiler/archive manifest hashes. Outer success checks require actual live result and current capture references.
Same900s/600CPU/4GiB/32process/1GiBscratch/96MiBtrace bounds. No new runtime device/network grant.
Source contains no original-board, CPU synchronization or physical calibration upgrade.
Final cleanup removes unused blocking write_request and compiles peer-side decode/packing/read/edge-reference helpers only in tests. Actual supervisor framing and validators are unchanged.
